voltage.note: Mean Well IRM-03-3.3, SPECIFICATION p. 2: DC voltage 3.3 V, voltage tolerance +/-2.5% (Note 3: includes set-up tolerance, line and load regulation). Note 1: 230 VAC input, rated load, 25 C.

rInternal.note: Derived from the load regulation, +/-1.0% (IRM-03-3.3, SPECIFICATION p. 2): band +/-1% x 3.3 V = +/-0.033 V, whole swing up to 0.066 V over 0 to 900 mA, 0.066 / 0.9 = 0.0733 ohm. Mean Well's IRM datasheet does not define load regulation (Note 3 only says the tolerance includes it); its NGE12 sibling Note 6 says it is measured from 0% to 100% rated load, and the plus-minus figure is a band, so the whole 0 to rated-load swing can be up to twice the figure. This value uses that upper bound (real units usually droop less). Controller ruling (reviewers disagreed): the two readings are 0.037 ohm (the +/-x% figure taken as the whole no-load to full-load swing) and 0.073 ohm (a band about a reference, up to twice the swing). 0.037 ohm is used: it is nearer typical droop, and this estimate never blocks.

imax.note: Mean Well IRM-03-3.3, SPECIFICATION p. 2: rated current 900 mA, current range 0 to 900 mA. Note 1: 230 VAC input, 25 C; derate at high temperature per the "Derating Curve".

notes: The DC output is a source only when the converter is powered in the saved contact state (spec 4 table); otherwise it is open. That is solver logic, not data.
imax is the rated output current, compared as a rating; the module's own protection (overload at 105% to 260% of rated output power, hiccup mode) is not modelled.

corrected.why: load regulation +/-x% is a band about a reference output, so the 0 to rated-load swing can be up to 2x%; doubled (NGE12 Note 6: measured from 0% to 100% rated load)
